blocks.text: Litware makes scheduling software for small clinics and is hiring a product designer to join its core team.
Design end-to-end flows for booking, intake and billing, from research to shipped screens.
Run interviews and usability tests with clinic staff and patients.
Maintain and extend the shared component library in Figma.
Work closely with engineers and product managers through delivery.
3+ years of experience designing web or mobile products.
A portfolio that shows how you approach research and interaction design.
Experience working with a design system and tokens in Figma.
Familiarity with accessibility standards such as WCAG 2.1 AA.
